NFL Games This Sunday: Oct 4 TV & Times

body: Week 4 of the NFL season is Sunday, and all 32 teams play this week. Here is the full slate in Pacific time so you can plan the day.
The morning starts early. The Indianapolis Colts and Washington Commanders play in London at 6:30 a.m. Pacific on NFL Network.

At 10 a.m. Pacific, eight games kick off. On CBS: Titans at Ravens, Patriots at Bills, Jaguars at Bengals and Cardinals at Giants. On Fox: Jets at Bears, Cowboys at Texans, Rams at Eagles and Packers at Buccaneers. Which ones you see depends on your local market.

The afternoon window has a strong West Coast flavor. Dolphins at Vikings is at 1:05 p.m. Pacific on Fox. At 1:25 p.m. on CBS, the Chiefs visit the Raiders, the Chargers visit the Seahawks and the Broncos visit the 49ers. CBS games also stream on Paramount+.
Sunday Night Football is Lions at Panthers at 5:20 p.m. Pacific on NBC and Peacock. The week wraps up Monday with Falcons at Saints at 5:15 p.m. Pacific on ESPN and ESPN2.
Extreme heat warnings remain in effect through Oct. 8 for much of Southern California. If you are tailgating or heading to a watch party outside, plan for shade and plenty of water.
If you play fantasy football, check your lineup tonight, since the London game kicks off before most West Coast fans are awake.
